# The Cryptic Owl

> Nine free daily puzzles at medium difficulty: a variant sudoku, a British cryptic crossword clue, "What Am I Talking About?" (five clues to a hidden subject), a single story-style trivia question answered in free text, Chronology (order six events from today's date), a chess mate-in-three-to-five, a cryptogram of a famous saying, Slitherlink (draw one loop round the numbers), and Higher or Lower (five close calls on a daily theme). New puzzles every day at midnight local time.

## Puzzles

- [All of today's puzzles](https://thecrypticowl.com/): the home page grid
- [Variant Sudoku](https://thecrypticowl.com/sudoku): 6×6 sudoku with a different rule each weekday (Diagonal, Kropki, Thermo, Arrow, Sandwich, Jigsaw, Killer)
- [Cryptic Clue](https://thecrypticowl.com/cryptic): one British cryptic crossword clue with step-by-step hints
- [What Am I Talking About?](https://thecrypticowl.com/what-am-i): guess a country, person, band, brand or festival from five clues
- [Trivia](https://thecrypticowl.com/trivia): ten multiple-choice questions, each with its source
- [Chronology](https://thecrypticowl.com/chronology): put six "on this day" events in order
- [Checkmate](https://thecrypticowl.com/chess): a forced mate in three to five moves, from the Lichess puzzle database
- [Cryptogram](https://thecrypticowl.com/cryptogram): decode a public-domain quote or proverb
- [Slitherlink](https://thecrypticowl.com/slitherlink): draw a single loop on a 6×6 grid of dots; each number counts the loop's sides around it
- [Higher or Lower](https://thecrypticowl.com/higher-lower): five rounds of which is bigger, taller or longer, with numbers from Wikidata

## Learn

- [About](https://thecrypticowl.com/about): what the site is, how puzzles are made, and a form to suggest new puzzle types
- [Cryptic crossword tutorial](https://thecrypticowl.com/learn): how cryptic clues work — definitions, indicators, fodder and every wordplay type
